BHI.why: Designs and builds heat-recovery steam generators (HRSGs) for gas combined-cycle plants (65.4% of H1 2026 revenue) and supplies gas-turbine OEMs Doosan Enerbility and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries; new gas combined-cycle capacity for rising power demand drives its orders.
BHI.evidence: BHI Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026) half-year report: HRSG revenue KRW 377,362M (65.4%); order backlog KRW 2,456,886M; percentage-of-completion contract table lists HRSG contracts with Doosan Enerbility and MHI (2025-10-10, KRW 267,458,789,938).

players.product: heat-recovery steam generators (HRSGs) for gas combined-cycle plants, plus utility boilers and balance-of-plant equipment

connects_to.relationship: HRSG and boiler supply for Doosan Enerbility power-plant projects

quarterly_data.signal: Boiler and HRSG design capability comes from technology licences with Amec Foster Wheeler, Sumitomo SHI FW and Siemens (5-20 year terms) and acquired PC-boiler (2017) and HRSG (2020) source technology. R&D in progress includes an ultra-supercritical HRSG for standard gas combined-cycle plants (2021.06-2027.05) and optimal HRSG design for hydrogen co-fired combined-cycle plants (2024.10-2026.09). Management expects HRSG competition to ease somewhat as some companies restructure, and expects power-equipment orders to increase as electricity demand grows
